mechanism: ShadowLedger(..., horizon_policy: dict[str, timedelta] | None = None) -- maps a Decision.horizon label to a deadline duration, computed from the position's ACTUAL hypothetical_fill_time (never the decision/recommendation time).
why_empty: The only horizon value any real caller ever attaches to a Decision today is decision_engine.NATURAL_STRATEGY_HORIZON = 'INTRADAY_SHORT'. Searched the full repository (talonx_core/consumer.py, talonx_paper/*, talonx_dispatch/*, talonx_watchlist/*, research/scripts/*) for any existing minute/hour value tied to that label -- none exists. Per this task's explicit instruction ('Missing horizon policy must not be silently replaced with an arbitrary holding period'), no duration is invented. A production Decision's shadow position therefore has horizon_deadline=None and exits only via stop/target/EOD, exactly as it did before this stage.
deadline_calculation: fill_time (the bar whose OPEN the shadow position actually filled at, not the decision/recommendation timestamp) + horizon_policy[horizon]
which_observations_can_execute_the_exit: Only a bar with bar.timestamp >= horizon_deadline, observed via ShadowLedger.on_bar -- the FIRST such bar causally reachable. Checked AFTER stop/target on the same bar (price-risk management takes precedence on a same-bar tie).
exit_price_used: The triggering bar's real, observed close price -- never a price interpolated or fabricated at the exact deadline instant.
no_executable_observation_at_expiry: If force_close (EOD or any other forced flatten) is reached while horizon_deadline has already passed with no intervening bar ever observed, exit_reason is reclassified to the explicit 'HORIZON_EXPIRED_NO_EXECUTABLE_OBSERVATION' (distinct from ordinary 'END_OF_SESSION') -- still uses the real, observed flatten price supplied by the caller, never fabricated.
late_arriving_data: A bar observed well after the deadline (following a data gap) still causally executes the horizon exit at THAT bar's real close/timestamp -- never backdated to the nominal deadline. holding_seconds correctly reflects the true, longer-than-nominal holding period.
missing_data_before_any_fill: A PENDING_FILL position (decision made, but no later bar ever observed to establish a causal fill) whose horizon would already have expired if it had filled is left PENDING_FILL -- never treated as if it had filled and immediately exited. force_close resolves it UNRESOLVED / UNRESOLVED_NO_FILL_BEFORE_HORIZON_END (unchanged from Task 77I's existing behavior).
restart_safety: horizon_deadline is a persisted, primitive ISO-string field on ShadowPosition (full-file JSON, same pattern as every other ledger in this codebase) -- a freshly-constructed ShadowLedger pointed at the same state_path and the same horizon_policy sees the identical deadline and resumes horizon-exit checking correctly.
broker_isolation: ShadowLedger has zero import of or reference to lifecycle.py/broker.py/order_intent anywhere in the module (grep-confirmed, also proven by test_shadow_deadline_never_touches_broker_or_lifecycle via source inspection) -- a horizon deadline structurally cannot send a broker order.
